title: The evaluation recovery command is valid navigation that parses through the real CLI
outcome: The recovery navigation emitted for a missing or stale evaluation is a command the CLI accepts, proven by parsing the emitted string rather than by substring checks
acceptance: the emitted recovery command for MissingAcceptanceEvaluation and AcceptanceEvaluationStale is passed through the real CLI parser in a regression test and parses as a read-only show with notes and gates, with no --full alongside them, no pre-filled verdict, and the full/detail exclusivity unchanged

completion.summary: The missing/stale evaluation recovery command is now "engram work show REF --notes --gates", valid under the CLI's full/detail exclusivity (unchanged), read-only, with no pre-filled verdict. Regression in the mcp-dogfood evaluated-policy test parses and runs the emitted command through the real CLI binary for both causes and asserts the item's revision unchanged; the unit test pins the exact string. RED logs/35 (CLI conflict) and 35b, GREEN logs/36 and 36b; final sequence logs/37 (fmt-check, check, clippy, lib 1109/4 ignored, bin 43, parity 31, mcp-dogfood 45, doc links) all pass; eight gates recorded here once. Docs updated in the recovery section.
